structured.answer: I haven't decided anything. The page says the cheapest is פסגות with the "ילין לפידות מחקה S&P 500" fund: about 86,492 ₪ left after ten years on 70,000 ₪ put in, against 79–83 thousand at the big banks. But that rests on 7% a year that I never typed in, so I'll ask my son or the bank before I do anything.

findings.what: Many red minus numbers in a column. They look like losses and scared me off every option.
The 7% a year was already filled in, and the big 86,492 figure rests on it. Nothing nearby says it could also go down.
Each fund repeats the same coloured labels (קרן סל, צוברת, חשיפה לדולר, מס גם על שינויי המטבע). I had to read them all again on each one to find the difference.
Numbers sit inside coloured bar segments and the key is separate below, with colours too close to tell apart.
Pale greyed-out rows and a grey window on top of them that I couldn't read.
